_help: Who runs the site, and how to reach them. Shown in the footer of every page, on the Contact page, and in the privacy policy and terms. A null value shows as a bracketed placeholder ([ADDRESS] / [INDIRIZZO]) and is listed as a warning by `npm run build`. See README.md.

company._help: Stage 1, before incorporation: the founders run the site and are joint data controllers. Do not add 'S.r.l.', a VAT number or a registered office until the company exists: after incorporation, use the footer template kept as an HTML comment in src/layout.mjs and update the privacy policy and terms (README → Stage 2).
